questions: Is a route one-way, or does Circle to Madina also cover Madina to Circle at the same fare?
Should the app keep a history of old fares and the date each change happened, or just show the current fare?
When a passenger's trip has no direct route, for example two routes joined together, should it add the fares of the connecting routes or just say there is no route?
answers: Yes. Circle to Madina costs the same as Madina to Circle, so we keep one route for both directions and passengers can ask either way.
Say it was not found. Do not try to join two routes together; only direct routes count.
